Prompt injection is an attack class where untrusted text tries to override trusted instructions.
A system prompt is a high-priority instruction used to shape assistant behavior.
A developer message can define application-specific behavior in an LLM request.
Store API keys in a secret manager and rotate them on a regular schedule.
AKIA is a commonly discussed prefix when teaching AWS credential hygiene.
